label: rem:embeddable-cardinality-vs-energy
title: Overlap weighting changes energy, not channel count
html:
Remark. Overlap weighting changes energy, not channel count

Overlap weighting changes only the energy, never the channel count. Every channel with w > 0 is occupied, so the active-set cardinality (the bond order of the CO LP dual) is independent of the weights. The equal-channel model (w \equiv 1) overbinds: for the \sigma + 2\pi triple bond it gives 1.42\times the observed D_0(\mathrm{N_2}). A lateral weight w_\perp \in [0.3, 0.7] brackets it (witness embeddable-knot-operator).
